# OriginUSDArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/OriginUSDArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ArkWithWithdrawalRequest](../ark-with-withdrawal-request.md)

**Title:**
OriginUSDArk

Ark contract for managing ETH/USDC deposits into Origin USD protocol

Implements strategy for depositing into Origin USD, withdrawing tokens, and tracking yield


## State Variables
### DECIMALS_OFFSET
The decimals offset between OUSD (18 decimals) and USDC (6 decimals)


```solidity
uint256 private constant DECIMALS_OFFSET = 1e12
```


### DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE
Default slippage for swaps


```solidity
uint256 private constant DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE = 15
```


### originUSD
The Origin USD contract this Ark interacts with


```solidity
IOriginUSD public immutable originUSD
```


### originUSDVault
The Origin USD vault address


```solidity
IOriginUSDVault public immutable originUSDVault
```


### withdrawalRequestId
The request ID for the withdrawal


```solidity
uint256 public withdrawalRequestId
```


## Functions
### constructor

Constructor to set up the OriginUSDArk


```solidity
constructor(address _originUSD, ArkParams memory _params) ArkWithWithdrawalRequest(_params, DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE);
```

### totalAssets

Returns the total assets managed by this Ark in the Origin USD protocol


```solidity
function totalAssets() public view override(Ark, IArk) returns (uint256 assets);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The total balance of underlying assets held in the vault for this Ark, including any pending withdrawal amounts|


### assetsInWithdrawalQueue

Returns the assets in the withdrawal queue.


```solidity
function assetsInWithdrawalQueue() public view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|assets The amount of underlying assets currently pending withdrawal.|


### withdrawUsingSwap

Withdraws assets from the Ark using a swap

This function is only callable by the keeper


```solidity
function withdrawUsingSwap(uint256 amount, bytes calldata data) external onlyKeeper nonReentrant;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to withdraw|
|`data`|`bytes`|The data to pass to the swap (router and swap calldata)|


### requestWithdrawal

Requests a withdrawal of underlying assets from the Ark.

This function is only callable by the keeper.


```solidity
function requestWithdrawal(uint256 amount) external onlyKeeper;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of underlying asset to request a withdrawal for.|


### claimWithdrawal

Claims a previously requested withdrawal of underlying assets from the Ark.

This function is only callable by the keeper.


```solidity
function claimWithdrawal() external onlyKeeper;
```

### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Internal function to get the total assets that are withdrawable

Returns the sum of the direct asset balance and the redeemable amount from Origin USD
limited by the ARM balance


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal view override returns (uint256 withdrawableAssets);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`withdrawableAssets`|`uint256`|Assets that can be immediately withdrawn|

### _harvest

Internal function for harvesting rewards

This function is a no-op as Origin USD auto-compounds the rewards


```solidity
function _harvest(bytes calldata)
    internal
    pure
    override
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint256[] memory rewardAmounts);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes`||

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardTokens`|`address[]`|The addresses of the reward tokens (empty array in this case)|
|`rewardAmounts`|`uint256[]`|The amounts of the reward tokens (empty array in this case)|

## Errors
### AssetMismatch
Error thrown when the asset in ArkParams doesn't match USDC


```solidity
error AssetMismatch();
```

### InvalidOriginUSDAddress
Error thrown when an invalid Origin USD address is provided


```solidity
error InvalidOriginUSDAddress();
```

### InsufficientAssetBalance
Error thrown when there is insufficient asset balance


```solidity
error InsufficientAssetBalance();
```

### InvalidOriginUSDVaultAddress
Error thrown when an invalid Origin USD vault address is provided


```solidity
error InvalidOriginUSDVaultAddress();
```
